model_choice: Exact binary formulation with helper coverage variables. N~35 sites => 70 variables. Fits easily in CGA backend (limit ~3600). Uses linear constraints for cardinality and coverage implications.

lat.meaning: Latitude of each site in degrees

lon.meaning: Longitude of each site in degrees

k.meaning: Number of charging stations to select

coverage.meaning: Binary coverage matrix: 1 if site j covers site i within 1km
